maddeler.e:
نرتكن (form VIII)
# نَرْتَكِنُ (nartakinu) /nar.ta.ki.nu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِرْتَكَنَ (irtakana)
# نَرْتَكِنَ (nartakina) /nar.ta.ki.na/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَكَنَ (irtakana)
# نَرْتَكِنْ (nartakin) /nar.ta.kin/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِرْتَكَنَ (irtakana)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
